content: Customer Pranav Mishra called insurance agent Vikram Singh to inquire why his auto policy (AP-001234) was not showing as active. The agent explained there was a payment processing backlog, escalated the issue, and provided a temporary reference number (TR-009876). The agent also promised to send a follow-up email with the details.

action_items: Agent to resolve the payment processing backlog and reinstate the policy
Agent to send a follow-up email with details to the customer
